title: Convert many video files to MP4 with ffmpeg in one loop
summary: Converts every .mkv and .avi file in a folder to an .mp4 file in another folder, one after another. The original videos stay where they are. An output file that already exists is not overwritten.

aliases.text: convert many videos to mp4 ffmpeg loop
convert all avi files to mp4 linux
ffmpeg convert every video in a folder
re-encode many videos in a folder
конвертировать все видео в mp4 ffmpeg
перевести mkv в mp4 для всех файлов

steps.explain: Preview only: print the ffmpeg command that would run for each input file. Nothing is converted yet. -n tells ffmpeg never to overwrite an output file.
steps.cmd: for f in <SRC_DIR>/*.mkv <SRC_DIR>/*.avi; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; b=$(basename "$f"); printf 'ffmpeg -n -i %q -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -c:a aac %q\n' "$f" "<OUT_DIR>/${b%.*}.mp4"; done
steps.expect: Lines such as: ffmpeg -n -i videos/raw/clip\ one.mkv -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -c:a aac videos/mp4/clip\ one.mp4

placeholders.name: OUT_DIR
placeholders.description: Folder for the MP4 files; it is created if missing

steps.explain: Convert each file. Errors are printed as FAILED, which also appears when the output file already exists. -crf 23 is a common quality setting; a lower number gives better quality and bigger files.
steps.cmd: mkdir -p <OUT_DIR> && for f in <SRC_DIR>/*.mkv <SRC_DIR>/*.avi; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; b=$(basename "$f"); ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -n -i "$f" -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -c:a aac "<OUT_DIR>/${b%.*}.mp4" || echo "FAILED or already exists: $f"; done
steps.expect: No output while it works; FAILED lines appear only for errors or existing outputs. Large videos take a long time.

steps.explain: List the converted files with their sizes.
steps.expect: One .mp4 file per input video, with a size in the list.

prerequisites: ffmpeg installed with the libx264 encoder
Enough free disk space for the new files
warnings: Re-encoding is slow and can lower quality. Keep the originals until you have checked the results.
Files without the listed extensions (for example .mov) are not converted by this loop.
